summary: Verified iter 30 fixes for perf (gold-orbit removed), animated gold gradient inside game cards, admin link full-page navigation cache-bust, and version bump to 2026.02.24.7. All 6 FIX items (A-F) verified successfully via DOM inspection + browser automation.

FIX_A_heavy_orbit_removed.evidence: DOM scan: has_gold_orbit=false, has_gold_sweep=false. Exactly 3 ambient layers under .fixed.inset-0.-z-10: layer1=gold-ambient-pulse (blur 55px), layer2=gold-drift (blur 55px), layer3=violet (blur 60px, no anim). All under 70px blur as required.

FIX_B_in_card_gold_gradient.evidence: 6/6 game cards contain a child <span class='... gold-ambient-pulse'> with position:absolute, mixBlendMode:'screen', and a linear-gradient(120deg, ... rgba(255,215,0,0.05/0.12) ... ) background. Matches FIX B spec exactly.

FIX_C_admin_full_page_nav.evidence: data-testid='admin-panel-link' is an <a> tag (not React Router Link). href='/admin?_t=<timestamp>'. First click -> /admin?_t=1782324641163. Second click (after navigating back to dashboard) -> /admin?_t=1782324650027. Timestamps DIFFER between clicks (~9s apart, fresh each time), confirming full-page navigation with cache-bust.

FIX_D_version_v7.evidence: curl GET /api/version returned {"version":"2026.02.24.7"}. versionCheck.js APP_BUILD_VERSION constant matches.

FIX_E_regression.evidence: Dashboard renders 6 game cards, 6 yesterday boxes, 6 today boxes, 6 chart buttons; 1 play button + 5 timeout buttons (time-of-day dependent, total=6 = one per card). Welcome popup dismissed via sessionStorage flag.

FIX_F_perf_smoke.evidence: first-contentful-paint=484ms (<1s requirement). 5 rapid scroll cycles up/down produced 0 JS errors. No gold-orbit/gold-sweep/heavy conic-gradient in DOM.

critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing React warning observed during admin-login redirect: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component'. Likely a setState during render in some auth/redirect logic. Not blocking but worth investigating (not introduced by this iteration). No JS errors otherwise.
